name: Supergateway
summary: Runs MCP stdio servers over Streamable HTTP or SSE, or bridges a remote SSE/Streamable HTTP server back to stdio, using a single npx command.
description: Examples: `npx -y supergateway --stdio "uvx mcp-server-git"`, `npx -y supergateway --sse <url>`, `npx -y supergateway --streamableHttp <url>`. npm `supergateway` 4.2.0.
